summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Iteration 18 features: 5 Operational Modules (Customer Credits, Purchase Inbound, Delivery Outbound, Brand Returns, Weekly Audits). All 38 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified working correctly via Playwright UI tests.
passed_tests: Admin login with credentials (admin@sensoper.com / Admin@123)
Sidebar: All 5 new nav links exist (Customer Credits, Purchase Inbound, Delivery Outbound, Brand Returns, Weekly Audits)
CUSTOMER CREDITS MODULE:
GET /api/credits returns list of credits
POST /api/credits creates credit entry with customer_name, total_amount, due_date
Credit appears in list after creation with status 'active'
POST /api/credits/{id}/pay records payment and updates balance
Balance updates correctly after payment (total - paid = balance)
Credit auto-closes when fully paid (status changes to 'closed')
Filter by status works (all, active, overdue, closed)
UI: KPI cards show Total Outstanding, Overdue count, 0-30 Days, 60+ Days aging
UI: Credits table displays customer, invoice, total, paid, balance, status, due date
UI: Pay button opens payment form with amount and method fields
PURCHASE INBOUND MODULE:
GET /api/purchase-orders returns list of POs
POST /api/purchase-orders creates PO with supplier, items, expected_delivery
PO appears in list with status 'pending' and calculated total_amount
PUT /api/purchase-orders/{id}/approve changes status to 'approved'
PUT /api/purchase-orders/{id}/arrival records transport details, status to 'arrived'
PUT /api/purchase-orders/{id}/qc records QC check results, status to 'qc_done'
PUT /api/purchase-orders/{id}/inbound completes PO with storage location, status to 'completed'
Filter by status works (all, pending, approved, arrived, qc_done, completed)
UI: Page shows lifecycle description (PO → Approve → Arrival → QC → Inventory)
UI: PO cards show supplier, items count, total amount, status badge, action buttons
DELIVERY OUTBOUND MODULE:
GET /api/deliveries returns list of deliveries
POST /api/deliveries creates delivery with customer, items, transport details
Delivery appears in list with status 'dispatched'
PUT /api/deliveries/{id}/complete marks delivery as 'delivered'
UI: Delivery cards show customer, items, dispatch date, transporter, vehicle
UI: Mark Delivered button completes delivery
BRAND RETURNS MODULE:
GET /api/returns returns list of returns
POST /api/returns creates return with item_name, quantity, reason (damage/excess/defect)
Return appears in list with status 'pending' and reason badge
PUT /api/returns/{id}/complete marks return as 'completed'
UI: KPI cards show Pending and Completed counts
UI: Return cards show item, quantity, reason badge, supplier, Complete button
WEEKLY AUDITS MODULE:
GET /api/audits returns list of audits
POST /api/audits creates audit with title, auditor_name, checklist items
Audit appears in list with status 'open' and checklist tags
PUT /api/audits/{id}/issue adds issue to audit with description and severity
PUT /api/audits/{id} changes status (open → in_progress → resolved)
Filter by status works (all, open, in_progress, resolved)
UI: KPI cards show Total Audits, Open, Issues Found
UI: Audit cards show title, auditor, deadline, checklist items as tags, issues with severity
UI: Issue, Start, and Resolve buttons work correctly
